contextual_value.statement: What can be supported is narrow and tied to context. One small unblinded adult cohort reported symptom improvement and rash; the label keeps the indication to adults, cautions in severe renal impairment, and records that pediatric safety is not established. The useful content is the boundary of what is known.

content_constraints: Keep the labelled population (adults) attached to every statement of use.
Keep the severe renal impairment caution attached to any statement of use.
State the pediatric position as the label states it: safety in children has not been established.
Describe the cohort as unblinded, of 20 adults, with no comparator and no adjudication, whenever its counts are used.
Do not place the invented cohort on the same footing as a label statement or a controlled trial.
